movelist.name: Heavy Slam
movelist.effect: For each weight class the user is above the target, increase Heavy Slam’s damage base by +2.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

movelist.name: Dynamic Punch
movelist.effect: Dynamic Punch Confuses the target. Dynamic Punch ignores the target’s Evasion if they are Flanked.

movelist.name: Magnitude
movelist.effect: When you use Magnitude, roll 1d6.  Magnitude’s Damage Base is equal to 5+X, where X is the value of the d6. Magnitude can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

abilities.name: Prime Fury
abilities.effect: The user becomes Enraged, and gains +1 Combat Stage in each of Attack and Special Attack.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.effect: The user gains a +3 bonus to all Attack Rolls; however all foes gain a +3 Bonus on Attack Rolls against the user.
